capabilities.rationale: Human-selected packet tasks WB007-T14..T21 require registration, login, logout, profile and session state (packet backend tier: Tier 2 - High).
Human-selected packet task WB007-T18 exercises password reset through request, validation and recovery.
Packet task WB007-T15 (email/account verification) and WB007-T18 need verification/recovery mail; real mail only to the user-controlled test inbox per packet authority.
Packet tasks WB007-T28..T34 cover booking confirmation, ticket details and post-booking management of persisted orders.
Packet tasks WB007-T26..T28 and WB007-T48 require a ticket checkout flow ending in a confirmation state.
Packet tasks WB007-T26 and WB007-T38 require payment method and payment-failure/retry semantics; clone uses local-sandbox only, live payment forbidden by packet authority.
Persistent accounts, saved favourites (WB007-T13), orders and preference state require the per-site isolated SQLite database.
